Package io.webagent4j.browser

package io.webagent4j.browser
Backend-neutral browser, page, and frame contracts - no Playwright (or other native backend) type appears in any public signature here.

Entry points: IBrowser owns a browser process and isolated context; IPage is one tab, exposing navigation, Observations, locators, actions, and extraction; IFrame mirrors IPage's contract scoped to one <iframe> document boundary and is re-resolved by semantic identity on every operation, never a frozen snapshot - see its class documentation for the exact re-resolution contract. IFrameLocator resolves an IFrame, mirroring ILocator at the document-boundary level.

IBrowserProvider is the extension point a backend module (currently only webagent4j-browser-playwright) implements and registers through ServiceLoader; application code obtains an implementation through WebAgent.browser() (module webagent4j-core), never by referencing a provider directly.
